regional.title: Regional Director configuration
regional.description: One Regional Director per region; each director manages only one region. Appoint registered members.
regional.full: All 3 regions — Northern, Central and Southern — are assigned. Each region has only one director; revoke the current appointment before appointing someone else.

policy.ruleText: Rules: Media Soft shares actual collected revenue only with Regional Directors · only members registered through affiliate links in the region qualify; direct registrations without referral links are Media Soft marketing costs and are not shared with Regional Directors · year 1: Media Soft {ms1}% / Regional Director {g1}% · the director share decreases by {step}% on each annual renewal · after reaching {min}%, it stays at that level long-term to support staffing costs · Regional Directors decide how much to share with group leaders & affiliates; affiliate commission figures in the system are for the directors' reference and reconciliation.
policy.ruleAuto: Members who have paid their membership fees automatically become affiliates.
policy.ruleFirst: Commission applies only to the first fee payment, not renewals.
policy.rulePause: An affiliate with expired membership fees stops accruing new commission.
policy.rulePayout: Commission is transferred once on the last day of each month.
policy.regionalTitle: Actual collected revenue sharing · Media Soft ↔ Regional Directors
policy.regionalHint: Media Soft shares only with Regional Directors · only affiliate-link registrations qualify · Regional Directors distribute shares to group leaders & downstream affiliates themselves
policy.regionalInvalid: The minimum rate must not exceed the first-year rate
policy.floorHint: Keep {percent}% for Regional Directors to support staffing costs
policy.shareNote: Applied to annual fees actually collected · no revenue sharing during the 3-month free trial · the customer year starts from the first fee payment · the Rate column for each commission states "Year 1 / Year 2 · renewal / sharing ended" · the Regional Director share covers the entire assigned region and is recorded and paid on the Regional Directors tab.

referenceBanner: Affiliates are paid by Regional Directors from their regional revenue share. Media Soft does not pay affiliates directly; it pays only Regional Directors on the Regional Directors tab. These figures support the directors' reconciliation.
